mapper.select: SELECT uh.hobby_id::TEXT AS row_id, uh.hobby_id, uh.level_cd, h.hobby_nm, lc.code_nm AS level_nm FROM t_user_hobby uh JOIN t_hobby h ON h.hobby_id = uh.hobby_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN t_code lc ON lc.code_id = uh.level_cd AND lc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' WHERE uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.sort_ordr, h.hobby_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId} AND hobby_id = #{hobbyId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_hobby (user_id, hobby_id, level_cd, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{hobbyId}::integer, #{levelCd}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_hobby SET level_cd = #{levelCd}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId} AND hobby_id = #{hobbyId}::integer
UPDATE t_user_hobby SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND hobby_id = #{hobbyId}::integer
